images.title: Times 11 is the number plus its shift
images.purpose: Shows 3874 × 11 as 38740 + 3874, where each column adds a digit and its right hand neighbour.
images.composition: One stacked column addition centred, large digits, one column highlighted. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: At the top, the label '3874 × 11'. Below it, a right aligned column addition in large dark digits: first row '38740', second row '+ 3874' with its 4 under the 0, a horizontal rule, then the answer row '42614'. Three small carry digits '1' sit above the hundreds, thousands and ten thousands columns. The hundreds column (7 above 8 above 6) is enclosed in a reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded box, with the label '8 + 7 + 1 = 16' beside it joined by a short leader line. Exactly 3 number rows, 3 carry digits, 1 highlight box.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Times 11 adds each digit to its neighbour, carrying when a sum reaches 10.

image_decisions.why: The one line rule comes from the shifted addition; seeing the columns explains the rule.
